title: Visual builder Inner row nested columns

entries.summary: Catalog/normalize/render Inner row (one nested Bootstrap row on mod.columns). Nested inner_row modules are dropped. Public class cms-mod-inner-row; compileStylesheet and plainText walk inner columns.

Canvas uses cms-lb-inner-col / cms-lb-inner-mod with data-kind inner_column/inner_module so outer module drag still uses .cms-lb-mod. No ⋮⋮ on nested chrome. Picker hides Inner row when already inside. Layers lists nested nodes without making them draggable.
No schema change. Inner columns live in layout_json and restore with the SQL dump. Extra nesting is stripped on save.
